credential_capture.label: Readwise access token
credential_capture.description: Use the Readwise access token for the account whose highlights this connection should collect.
credential_capture.submit_label: Create Readwise connection and start first sync

fields.name: secret
fields.label: Readwise access token
fields.help_text: Copy your access token from readwise.io/access_token, then paste it here.

refresh_policy.rationale: Readwise's export endpoint uses a long-lived token, is rate limited (HTTP 429 with Retry-After), and supports updatedAfter, so a daily incremental sync is enough.

streams.name: books
streams.description: Books, articles and other sources the owner has highlighted in Readwise.

display.label: Your Readwise sources
display.detail: Titles, authors, category, source, cover image, links, document notes and tags.

id.description: Stable Readwise user_book_id, stored as a decimal string.

title.description: Readable title of the source, falling back to its original title.

author.description: Author or creator of the source.

category.description: Readwise source category, such as books, articles, tweets or podcasts.

source.description: Service the source was imported from, such as kindle or reader.

cover_image_url.description: URL of the source's cover image.

source_url.description: Original source URL, falling back to Readwise's unique URL.

readwise_url.description: URL of the source in Readwise.

document_note.description: Owner's note on the source as a whole.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number when provided.

tags.description: Names of tags attached to the source.

is_deleted.description: Provider deletion flag. Deleted sources emit a tombstone.

text_encoding.description: Reversible encoding used by descriptive text and tag fields.

streams.name: highlights
streams.description: Every Readwise highlight with its note, tags, location and source book.

display.label: Your Readwise highlights
display.detail: Highlighted text, your notes, tags, colour, favourite flag, location, and the title and author of the source.

id.description: Stable Readwise highlight ID, stored as a decimal string.

book_title.description: Source title copied onto the highlight for independent search and display.

book_author.description: Source author copied onto the highlight.

location.description: Highlight position in the units described by location_type.

location_type.description: Units or ordering used for the highlight position.

url.description: URL associated with the individual highlight.

readwise_url.description: URL of the highlight in Readwise.

tags.description: Names of tags attached to the highlight.

is_favorite.description: Whether the owner marked this highlight as a favorite.

is_discard.description: Whether Readwise marked this highlight as discarded.

is_deleted.description: True when the highlight or its source is deleted. Emits a tombstone.

highlighted_at.description: Time the highlight was taken, when provided by Readwise.

created_at.description: Time the highlight was created in Readwise.

updated_at.description: Time the highlight was last updated in Readwise.

text_encoding.description: Reversible encoding used by descriptive text and tag fields.

reason_display_messages.readwise_auth_failed: Readwise did not accept the access token. Copy a fresh token from readwise.io/access_token and connect again.
